name: Artefacto de Deformación Facial
description: Detecta artefactos de deformación facial en videos deepfake
algorithm: Face Warping Artifact — Análisis Espacial a Nivel de Píxel
mechanism:
This method detects geometric warping artifacts in face-swap deepfakes:

1. **Rostro Geometry Análisis**: The 3D face geometry is estimated from 2D landmarks per frame. Face-swap methods warp the source face to match the target's geometry using affine or 3D morphable model transforms. Residual geometric artifacts from imperfect warping are detected.

2. **Warping Distorsión Detección**: Local geometric distortion is measured by analyzing: (a) unnaturally stretched or compressed facial regions, (b) non-uniform scaling inconsistent with perspective projection, (c) barrel/pincushion distortion not matching the camera's lens model. These warp residuals indicate face replacement.

3. **Facial Proportion Consistencia**: Key facial proportions (eye width/face width, nose length/face length, lip width/inter-ocular distance) are measured across frames. Natural proportions remain constant (bone structure doesn't change). Warping artifacts may cause subtle proportion fluctuations as the face swap adjusts to varying target poses.

4. **Grid Deformation Análisis**: A virtual grid overlaid on the face reveals local deformation patterns. The method applies thin-plate spline analysis to detect non-rigid warping — regions where straight lines on the face surface become curved. Natural faces don't exhibit such local deformation artifacts.

5. **Temporal Warping Estabilidad**: The warping field (if present) should be temporally smooth. The method analyzes the temporal consistency of detected geometric distortions. Frame-to-frame variations in warping artifacts — caused by independent per-frame face alignment — produce a high-frequency temporal signal distinguishing deepfakes from authentic video.
parameters:
Tipo de análisis: píxel
Medio: video
Entrada: Video frames extracted at key intervals
Salida: Puntuación de confianza (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: Moderada a Alta — 70-88% precisión independiente. Most effective when combined with other video forensic methods. Performance depends on video quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detección de deepfake y video generado por IA mediante face warping artifact analysis. Este método examina características temporales y espaciales que son difíciles de replicar perfectamente por sistemas de IA, proporcionando evidencia para la evaluación de autenticidad del video.
strengths:
• Captura artefactos temporales que el análisis de cuadro único pierde
• Funciona con formatos de video estándar
• Efectivo contra técnicas comunes de deepfake
• Se puede combinar con otros métodos forenses de video
• Basado en investigación establecida de visión por computadora
limitations:
• Rendimiento afectado por la compresión y resolución del video
• Algunos métodos requieren suficiente cantidad de cuadros para el análisis temporal
• La efectividad varía según la técnica de generación de deepfake
• Se usa mejor como parte de un pipeline integral de múltiples métodos
• Puede producir falsos positivos en videos auténticos con edición intensiva

references.title: Nirkin, Y. et al. (2019). FSGAN: Subject Agnostic Face Swapping and Reenactment. ICCV.
Rossler, A. et al. (2019). FaceForensics++: Learning to Detect Manipulated Facial Images. ICCV.
